assertions.name: B3 runtime requires explicit authorization, policy and normalizer, creates no work
B3 complete state reservation and policy precede exactly one POST
B3 immediate complete submit stores raw with operation, does not add GET
B3 early error at submit is preserved, not empty-success
B3 authorization failure does not reserve or fetch
B3 wrong owner fails before credentials/fetch
B3 credential context mismatch never claims or consumes budget
B3 global admission denied rolls back proven-unsent reserve, retains dedupe
B3 abort during external admission: no POST and no paid reserve
B3 a cancelled pending queue stays cancelled after an unsent reservation
B3 interruption after POST is UNKNOWN; a new command cannot replay
B3 storage commit failure after accepted POST stops progression and survives recovery
B3 raw read-result commit failure never becomes parsed success
B3 policy settlement failure preserves known operation and pauses new work
B3 GET waiting, failed read, then success use same saved ID
B3 unknown second submission does not discard earlier accepted result
B3 recovery of interrupted GET makes no network request and keeps ID
B3 parse failure retains raw; retry is local and never calls wire
B3 malformed saved response cannot become empty successful search
B3 read failure is not relabelled as parse failure
B3 a persisted successful result is never overwritten on repeated normalize
B3 exact same attempt after successful submit cannot pay for next item
B3 duplicate parallel execution grants one network boundary
B3 two runtime instances with same worker cannot both claim the selected item
B3 explicit slice count executes serially; replay stops at settled slot
B3 slice elapsed time bounds new work, never silently executes entire job
B3 slice stops immediately on unknown outcome
B3 malformed slice count and identity rejected locally
B3 no full-store read or full-response return during 100 explicit item operations
B3 edge: duplicate immediate settlement does not overwrite preserved response
B3 edge: operation collision rolls back new raw and all acceptance counters
B3 edge: duplicate not-sent settlement cannot credit the budget twice
B3 edge: genuine unknown cannot be changed to not-sent by stale attempt
B3 edge: released known-unsent reserve never removes pause
B3 edge: immediate receipt requires raw and operation before transition
B3 edge: rejected submit is failed, not empty success, reserve remains conservative
B3 edge: exact maximum budget blocks a further pending claim
B3: immediate submit result persisted atomically, no collect needed
B3: early provider error on submit retains operation and evidence
B3: known-unsent attempt returns item without charging, never reused
B3: preview identity mismatch rejects claim without consuming next item
B3: preview reads one item and context, no state writes
B3: normalization recovery reads exact single item without scanning

limits: No real IndexedDB, Chrome memory, integrated global policy, real XML-parser or installed extension PASS is implied. Functional tests use the real stored orchestration/transport/protocol code and the explicitly labelled test fixtures.
